submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original full-body transparent character master for the landscape SLG 五行问鼎. Create exactly ONE historical Three Kingdoms personality, not a troop type and not an elemental hero. This is a newly designed fictional visual interpretation of that identity; do not copy any commercial game's character art and do not depict historical design choices as documentary facts. References 1 and 2 are the required Taoist chibi hand-painted style references only: carry over the finely painted ivory fabric, restrained jade accents, warm gold cloud ornaments, soft rounded modeling and highly finished linework. The character peer is only a series/rendering/proportion reference, NOT a face or costume to copy. Preserve chibi large head, compact adult body, about 2.7-3 heads tall, differentiated adult face. Premium detailed 2D hand-painted game art, clean shapes, soft gold/metal and cloth texture, no plastic 3D toy look, no photographic anatomy. Render a vertical portrait canvas preferably 1024x1536 with REAL transparent RGBA background. Show the complete body, complete hair/hat, both boots, all sleeves and every weapon or scroll tip. Leave ample true transparent margins all around (at least 8%); keep subject compact enough that nothing touches the edge. Balanced three-quarter front pose, eyes visible, hands anatomically clear. No text, nameplate, watermark, scene, floor, cast shadow, vignette, halo, UI panel or glowing background. Do not add a decorative frame. 
Distinct identity design: Xun Yu 荀彧. A dignified mature civil counsellor, slim and upright, gently elongated oval face with high forehead, narrow thoughtful eyes, neat fine moustache and a short tidy pointed chin beard, calm courteous expression. Distinctive tall RECTANGULAR black woven scholar crown with two restrained horizontal gold ribs, no feather fan and no large round yin-yang badge. Ivory silk formal robe over deep jade-green inner layers, narrow patterned gold edging, orderly long sleeves, small jade waist pendant. Hold a rolled cream silk memorandum tied with a red cord in one hand, a small flat wooden writing tablet in the other, both entirely visible. Modest authoritative scholar silhouette; not Zhuge Liang's face, cap or fan.
